meta.name: to-spec
meta.description: Turn the current conversation into a spec and publish it to the project issue tracker: no interview, just synthesis of what you've already discussed.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 整理当前讨论为规格并发布到项目问题列表
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你们经常在讨论后需要把共识沉淀成正式规格并同步到项目管理工具。
copy.tagline_en: Turn your discussion into a spec and post it to the issue tracker.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to turn meeting discussions into a formal spec and share it with your team.

howto.what: 把当前对话和代码理解综合成一份 spec(即 PRD),过程中不向你提问。按固定模板写问题陈述、方案、用户故事、实现决策、测试决策等章节,再发布到项目 issue tracker,并打上 ready-for-agent 标签。
howto.when: 当你已经和 Claude 聊过需求,想把这部分内容整理成 spec 并发布到 issue tracker 时使用,该技能需手动调用。若未配置 issue tracker 与标签词表,需先运行 /setup-matt-pocock-skills。

say.text: 把刚才的讨论整理成 spec 发到 issue tracker
先跟我确认测试接缝位置,再写 spec 并发布
say.note: 接缝确认后才动笔,优先复用已有接缝

say.text: 按模板写份 PRD,重点列全用户故事

howto.what_en: A spec (PRD) from what you've already discussed — no interview. Uses a fixed template (problem, solution, user stories, implementation/testing decisions), then publishes it to the project issue tracker with a ready-for-agent label.
howto.when_en: After you've discussed requirements and want them written up as a spec and published to the issue tracker. Invoked manually; run /setup-matt-pocock-skills first if tracker and labels aren't set up.

say_en.text: Turn our discussion into a spec and publish it to the issue tracker
say_en.note: No interview — it synthesizes what's known and adds the ready-for-agent label

say_en.text: Confirm the test seams with me first, then write and publish the spec
say_en.note: It checks seams with you before writing; existing seams preferred

say_en.text: Write a PRD from this, with a full list of user stories
say_en.note: Stories use the 'As a <actor>, I want a <feature>, so that <benefit>' format
